checkpoints.title: Layer precedence before application configuration
checkpoints.contract: Resolve at most eight optional textual port layers, with later present values winning and default 8080. Validate only the effective value as a nonzero u16. The result stores a private validated port; this milestone does not read process environment/files or manage secrets.

checkpoints.title: Complete current reference
checkpoints.contract: The complete documented reference contract, including later project features. This is explicitly the final checkpoint, not an earlier milestone.
